process_area.title: Market Surveillance, Compliance Monitoring & Certification Analytics

value_stream.name: DTI-BPS Product Standards Certification & PS Mark/ICC Compliance

fields.Participants: Product Compliance Manager, Store Ops (links to VS-07), LP (links to VS-23), Quality (links to VS-31), Merchandising (links to VS-01), Audit (links to VS-21)
fields.Trigger: Monitoring cycle; risk-based audit; new product on shelf

workflows.name: In-Market Compliance Monitoring & Store Shelf Audit

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-validate of "verify PS Mark/ICC mark presence on regulated products on shelf, match to…" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-flag for investigation of "investigate a regulated product found on shelf without valid certification,…" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-log of "Product Compliance Manager/Audit publish compliance-monitoring results" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-582 (ensure controlled execution — Market Surveillance, Compliance Monitoring & Certification Analytics (PA-117.3).)
- operational: periodic audit; operational: exception root-cause and gating fix
Pain Points / Risks: - **Shelf-presence risk**: Regulated product on shelf without visible/current mark — illegal sale; mitigated by periodic audit
- **Gating-bypass risk**: Product reached shelf despite cert gate; mitigated by exception root-cause and gating fix
System Touchpoints: - Store operations (links to VS-07); loss prevention (links to VS-23); quality (links to VS-31); item master/regulated flag (links to W3666); stop-sell (links to W3684); audit (links to VS-21)

steps.activity: Product Compliance Manager/Store Ops conduct periodic in-market certification compliance audits across stores and DCs: verify PS Mark/ICC mark presence on regulated products on shelf, match to current certificates/licenses (links to W3666/W3667), and flag missing/expired marks for action
steps.r: Product Compliance Manager / Store Ops / LP

steps.activity: Product Compliance Manager manage exceptions: investigate a regulated product found on shelf without valid certification, determine root cause (PO/GR gating failure, license lapse, sticker not applied), and trigger stop-sell (links to W3684) and corrective action
steps.r: Product Compliance Manager / Quality / Store Ops

steps.activity: Product Compliance Manager/Audit publish compliance-monitoring results: certification-conformance rate by category/store/vendor, recurring failure patterns, and the corrective-action backlog; report to program governance (links to W3665) and audit (links to VS-21)
steps.r: Product Compliance Manager / Audit

fields.Participants: Product Compliance Manager, Regulatory Officer (links to VS-22), Legal (links to VS-100.3), Store Ops (links to VS-07), Merchandising (links to VS-01), Vendor Mgmt (links to VS-03), Audit (links to VS-21), Government Affairs (links to VS-104)
fields.Trigger: DTI-BPS market-surveillance notice; Oplan inspection; consumer/regulator complaint

workflows.name: DTI Market Surveillance Response & Oplan Coordination

Automation Opportunity: - System workflow orchestration of "coordinate the BuildRight response team" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-inspect of "Product Compliance Manager/Legal manage the inspection/response" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "report the market-surveillance event and outcome to governance" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-582 (ensure controlled execution — Market Surveillance, Compliance Monitoring & Certification Analytics (PA-117.3).)
- operational: in-market monitoring (W3681) and documentation (W3668); operational: proactive compliance and rapid response
Pain Points / Risks: - **Evidence-gap risk**: Cannot produce current certificate at inspection → deemed non-compliant; mitigated by in-market monitoring (W3681) and documentation (W3668)
- **Penalty exposure risk**: Sustained findings incur fines and product removal; mitigated by proactive compliance and rapid response
System Touchpoints: - Regulatory response (links to VS-22.2); legal (links to VS-100.3); store ops (links to VS-07); vendor (links to VS-03); governance (links to VS-36); government affairs (links to VS-104); audit (links to VS-21)

steps.activity: Product Compliance Manager/Regulatory Officer receive and triage the DTI market-surveillance action (Oplan visit, test-purchase, sampling notice, or complaint): confirm scope (product/store/standard), assemble the certification evidence (links to W3666–W3668), and coordinate the BuildRight response team
steps.r: Product Compliance Manager / Regulatory Officer / Legal

steps.activity: Product Compliance Manager/Legal manage the inspection/response: present current certificates/licenses/technical files, witness any sampling, manage the finding, and respond to DTI within deadlines; coordinate store cooperation (links to VS-07) and vendor involvement (links to VS-03)
steps.r: Product Compliance Manager / Legal / Store Ops / Vendor Mgmt

steps.activity: Product Compliance Manager manage the outcome: on a sustained finding, execute stop-sell/withdrawal (links to W3684) and corrective action, manage any penalty/fine, and report the market-surveillance event and outcome to governance (links to W3665/VS-36), audit (links to VS-21), and government-affairs intelligence (links to VS-104)
steps.r: Product Compliance Manager / Regulatory Officer / Legal

fields.Participants: Product Compliance Manager, Quality (links to VS-31), Customer Service (links to VS-13), Legal (links to VS-100.3/W185), Merchandising (links to VS-01), Vendor Mgmt (links to VS-03), Risk (links to VS-21.2)
fields.Trigger: Consumer complaint (links to VS-13); quality non-conformance; field failure
fields.Volume: Low frequency; links to product liability (W185)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-capture of "capture the product/SKU, batch, the failure mode, and the certification" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-review of "review the vendor's PS License/testing evidence, and determine whether the…" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-notify of "notify DTI-BPS if required, drive vendor CAPA" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-582 (ensure controlled execution — Market Surveillance, Compliance Monitoring & Certification Analytics (PA-117.3).)
- operational: re-test and vendor review; operational: regulatory triage
Pain Points / Risks: - **Under-investigation risk**: A safety failure on a certified product indicates systemic certification weakness; mitigated by re-test and vendor review
- **Reporting-obligation risk**: Certain non-conformances require DTI notification; mitigated by regulatory triage
System Touchpoints: - Customer service (links to VS-13); quality (links to VS-31); lab (links to W3676); product liability (links to W185); recall (links to VS-89); stop-sell (links to W3684); vendor CAPA (links to W3670)

steps.activity: Product Compliance Manager/Quality triage a consumer complaint or field failure on a regulated product for a potential certification non-conformance: capture the product/SKU, batch, the failure mode, and the certification status; determine if the issue indicates a standards/certification deficiency (vs. isolated defect)
steps.r: Product Compliance Manager / Quality / Customer Service

steps.activity: Product Compliance Manager/Quality investigate: sample and re-test against the PNS (links to W3676/W3680), review the vendor's PS License/testing evidence, and determine whether the product fails its certified standard; coordinate with product liability/consumer safety (links to W185) and recall (links to VS-89) where a safety deficiency is indicated
steps.r: Product Compliance Manager / Quality / Lab

steps.activity: Product Compliance Manager manage the outcome: on confirmed certification non-conformance, trigger stop-sell/corrective action (links to W3684), notify DTI-BPS if required, drive vendor CAPA (links to W3670), and recover cost (links to W3686); feed learning to standards mapping (W3666) and quality (links to VS-31)
steps.r: Product Compliance Manager / Vendor Mgmt / Legal

fields.Participants: Product Compliance Manager, Merchandising (links to VS-01), Store Ops (links to VS-07), DC (links to VS-04), Quality (links to VS-31), Import (links to VS-02.2), POS (links to VS-08), Recall (links to VS-89), Legal (links to VS-100.3)
fields.Trigger: Confirmed non-conformance (W3683); market-surveillance finding (W3682); license lapse (W3670)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-import of "import pending corrective action" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-log of "Product Compliance Manager/Quality determine the corrective action" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-validate of "verify certification/mark, lift the stop-sell, and restock" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-582 (ensure controlled execution — Market Surveillance, Compliance Monitoring & Certification Analytics (PA-117.3).)
- operational: rapid corrective action and re-release; operational: system-enforced stop-sell and DC/store reconciliation
Pain Points / Risks: - **Revenue-loss risk**: Stop-sale across 200 stores on a regulated SKU is costly; mitigated by rapid corrective action and re-release
- **Incomplete-withdrawal risk**: Some units remain on shelf/in-transit; mitigated by system-enforced stop-sell and DC/store reconciliation
System Touchpoints: - POS/ecommerce/marketplace stop-sell (links to VS-08/VS-10/VS-65); DC/quarantine (links to VS-04); reverse logistics (links to VS-32); recall (links to VS-89); quality CAPA (links to VS-31); vendor recovery (links to W3686)

steps.activity: Product Compliance Manager/Merchandising place the affected regulated product on stop-sale across stores, DC, ecommerce, and marketplace (links to VS-08/VS-04/VS-10/VS-65): set the SKU non-saleable, quarantine on-hand stock, and halt new PO/import pending corrective action
steps.r: Product Compliance Manager / Merchandising / Store Ops / DC

steps.activity: Product Compliance Manager/Quality determine the corrective action: vendor re-certification/re-test/re-marking, product rework, or withdrawal/destruction; coordinate the in-market withdrawal (links to VS-32 reverse logistics) and assess recall triggering (links to VS-89) where consumer safety is at issue
steps.r: Product Compliance Manager / Quality / Vendor Mgmt

steps.activity: Product Compliance Manager manage re-certification and re-release: confirm the corrective action, re-verify certification/mark, lift the stop-sell, and restock; capture the event cost and feed to vendor recovery (links to W3686), quality CAPA (links to VS-31), and program analytics (links to W3688)
steps.r: Product Compliance Manager / Merchandising / Quality

fields.Participants: Product Compliance Manager, Finance (links to VS-17.4), Import (links to VS-02.2), BI (links to VS-28.1), Merchandising (links to VS-01), Quality (links to VS-31)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-inspect of "inspection/witness labor, demurrage from certification delay, and…" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-analyze of "analyze certification lead-time and cost" (replaces manual Step 2).
Controls: - CTL-582 (ensure controlled execution — Market Surveillance, Compliance Monitoring & Certification Analytics (PA-117.3).)
- operational: full-cost capture; operational: lead-time analytics
Pain Points / Risks: - **Hidden-cost risk**: Certification cost not fully captured in landed cost, understating true COGS; mitigated by full-cost capture
- **Lead-time-blindness risk**: Certification delay not visible as a demurrage driver; mitigated by lead-time analytics
System Touchpoints: - Landed cost (links to W144/VS-02.2); finance/COGS (links to VS-17); BI (links to VS-28.1); merchandising (links to VS-01); program governance (links to W3665)

steps.activity: Product Compliance Manager/Finance capture the full certification cost per regulated SKU/shipment: BPS fees, accredited-lab testing, ICC stickers, inspection/witness labor, demurrage from certification delay, and re-test/failure cost; allocate to landed cost (links to W144/VS-02.2) and COGS (links to VS-17)
steps.r: Product Compliance Manager / Finance / Import

steps.activity: Product Compliance Manager/BI analyze certification lead-time and cost: ICC cycle-time by product/lab/lane, cost-per-SKU, cost-as-% of landed cost, and demurrage-attributable-to-certification; benchmark and identify optimization (lab selection, parallel filing, supplier shift to SOC)
steps.r: Product Compliance Manager / BI / Finance

steps.activity: Product Compliance Manager publish certification cost/lead-time analytics to merchandising (links to VS-01 — sourcing/pricing implications), FP&A (links to VS-17.4), and program governance (links to W3665); drive cost-reduction and lead-time actions into the program
steps.r: Product Compliance Manager / Finance / BI

fields.Owner: Product Compliance Manager / Vendor Management / Finance
fields.Participants: Product Compliance Manager, Vendor Mgmt (links to VS-03), Finance (links to VS-15/VS-17), Legal (links to VS-100.3), Vendor Scorecard (links to VS-67), Quality (links to VS-31)
fields.Trigger: Sample failure (W3679); non-conformance corrective action (W3684); DTI penalty

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-export of "export/destruction, freight and demurrage, re-procurement differential,…" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System workflow orchestration of "coordinate with legal on contested recovery" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "report recovery performance to program analytics" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-582 (ensure controlled execution — Market Surveillance, Compliance Monitoring & Certification Analytics (PA-117.3).)
- operational: clear contract indemnity and documentation; operational: root-cause attribution
Pain Points / Risks: - **Non-recovery risk**: Vendor disputes/contests the chargeback, leaving BuildRight to absorb the cost; mitigated by clear contract indemnity and documentation
- **Penalty-attribution risk**: DTI fine attributable to BuildRight (not vendor) is unrecoverable; mitigated by root-cause attribution
System Touchpoints: - Vendor management (links to VS-03); AP/chargeback (links to VS-15/W245); finance (links to VS-17); legal (links to VS-100); vendor scorecard (links to VS-67); vendor CAPA (links to W3670)

steps.activity: Product Compliance Manager/Finance quantify the recoverable certification-event cost: product loss/re-export/destruction, freight and demurrage, re-procurement differential, re-test, stop-sale revenue loss, and any DTI fine/penalty attributable to vendor non-conformance
steps.r: Product Compliance Manager / Finance / Quality

steps.activity: Product Compliance Manager/Vendor Mgmt/Legal pursue vendor recovery per contract indemnity: issue the debit memo/chargeback (links to VS-15/W245), negotiate settlement, and manage vendor dispute (links to VS-03.3/W869); coordinate with legal on contested recovery (links to VS-100)
steps.r: Product Compliance Manager / Vendor Mgmt / Legal / Finance

steps.activity: Product Compliance Manager capture recovery to closure, feed the event to the vendor scorecard (links to VS-67) and vendor CAPA (links to W3670), and report recovery performance to program analytics (links to W3688) and governance (links to W3665)
steps.r: Product Compliance Manager / Vendor Mgmt / Finance

fields.Owner: Product Compliance Manager / Cross-Entity Shared Services
fields.Participants: Product Compliance Manager, Cross-Entity Shared Services (links to VS-72), Regulatory Officer (links to VS-22), Legal (links to VS-100.3), Finance (links to VS-17.2), Records (links to VS-88), Audit (links to VS-21)
fields.Trigger: Multi-entity sourcing; entity-level certification obligation; consolidated reporting

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-logof "Product Compliance Manager coordinate certification across the 5" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-allocate of "allocate the cost per the shared-services model" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-record of "Records consolidate the certification register and reporting across entities…" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-582 (ensure controlled execution — Market Surveillance, Compliance Monitoring & Certification Analytics (PA-117.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Obligation-ambiguity risk**: Unclear which entity holds the certification obligation; mitigated by entity-mapping
- **Double/count risk**: Certification cost mis-allocated across entities; mitigated by shared-services allocation
System Touchpoints: - Cross-entity shared services (links to VS-72); consolidation (links to VS-17.2); records (links to VS-88); audit (links to VS-21); ICC/PS register (links to W3672)

steps.activity: Product Compliance Manager coordinate certification across the 5 legal entities (BuildRight Depot Inc. as inventory owner, Logistics Inc. at DCs, Digital Commerce Inc. online, Property Management Inc., Holdings): confirm which entity holds the certification obligation per sourcing/sale, manage entity-level BPS engagement, and reconcile shared regulated-stock certification status
steps.r: Product Compliance Manager / Cross-Entity Shared Services

steps.activity: Product Compliance Manager/Cross-Entity manage intercompany certification cost allocation: where one entity incurs certification cost on behalf of another (e.g., Depot Inc. inventory certified at a Logistics Inc. DC), allocate the cost per the shared-services model (links to VS-72.1) and intercompany billing (links to VS-72.2)
steps.r: Product Compliance Manager / Cross-Entity / Finance

steps.activity: Product Compliance Manager/Records consolidate the certification register and reporting across entities for group audit, BIR/SEC, and DTI-BPS purposes (links to VS-88/VS-17.2), and support entity-level and consolidated audit response (links to VS-21/W3672)
steps.r: Product Compliance Manager / Records / Cross-Entity

fields.Participants: Product Compliance Manager, BI (links to VS-28.1), Audit (links to VS-21), Merchandising (links to VS-01), Vendor Mgmt (links to VS-03), Quality (links to VS-31), Finance (links to VS-17.4), Governance (links to VS-36)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-register of "register coverage, PS-license currency rate, ICC cycle-time and clearance rate,…" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-analyze of "analyze trends and root causes" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "track effectiveness, and report program performance and maturity to governance" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-582 (ensure controlled execution — Market Surveillance, Compliance Monitoring & Certification Analytics (PA-117.3).)
- operational: KPI dashboard; operational: continuous-improvement cycle
Pain Points / Risks: - **Metric-blindness risk**: No visibility into certification performance trends; mitigated by KPI dashboard
- **Improvement-stall risk**: Issues recur without program change; mitigated by continuous-improvement cycle
System Touchpoints: - BI/analytics (links to VS-28.1); program governance (links to W3665); audit (links to VS-21); governance/board (links to VS-36); risk (links to VS-21.2)

steps.activity: Product Compliance Manager/BI maintain the certification program KPI dashboard: regulated-product register coverage, PS-license currency rate, ICC cycle-time and clearance rate, sticker integrity, market-surveillance findings, non-conformance rate, stop-sale events, certification cost/lead-time, and vendor recovery rate
steps.r: Product Compliance Manager / BI

steps.activity: Product Compliance Manager analyze trends and root causes: recurring non-conformance vendors/categories, lead-time drivers, cost outliers, and regulatory-change impact; identify program improvements (lab diversification, SOC shift, gating hardening, vendor development)
steps.r: Product Compliance Manager / Quality / Vendor Mgmt

steps.activity: Product Compliance Manager drive continuous improvement: implement program changes, track effectiveness, and report program performance and maturity to governance (links to W3665/VS-36), audit (links to VS-21), and the executive risk committee (links to VS-21.2)
steps.r: Product Compliance Manager
